summary: Worker build and pytest regression pass, but live UI/API verification is blocked by missing Next.js dev bundle chunks after hot reload.

critical.issue: Live requests returned HTTP 500 after frontend hot reload; logs show Cannot find module './873.js' from .next server bundle.

ui_bugs.issue: Live page rendered largely unstyled and had zero a[href*='/watch/'] links during browser check.
Requested watch URL returned HTTP 500; logs show missing vendor chunk sonner.js.

integration_issues.flow: Public API and homepage data loading
integration_issues.issue: API calls intermittently/ultimately returned 500 due missing Next.js generated chunks.

issues: Observed unstyled/default browser presentation during live browser run, likely caused by the broken dev bundle/assets.

action_items: Clear/rebuild the Next.js .next dev output or fix supervisor hot-reload chunk invalidation; retest all live API and route flows.
Verify production worker deployment rather than relying on the corrupted dev server state.
Update the public test fixture to source credentials from the approved credentials file instead of embedding stale credentials.
critical_code_review_comments: wrangler.json still declares a placeholder D1 database despite Turso being the primary engine; ensure deployment configuration intentionally preserves and documents this fallback.

success_rate.backend: 100% pytest / 0% live API at final check

context_for_next_testing_agent: yarn build:worker passed and produced frontend/.open-next/worker.js. pytest test_public_api_payloads and test_admin_login passed once. Subsequent live checks failed after hot reload with missing .next chunks; rerun after restarting/rebuilding frontend.
rca of the issue: Supervisor frontend logs report Cannot find module './873.js' in the API route bundle and Cannot find module './vendor-chunks/sonner.js' for the watch page. The generated .next development bundle became inconsistent during hot reload, causing server-side route/API 500 responses and incomplete client rendering.
